tagline: A desktop GIS viewer that layers rasters and vectors and runs YOLO rooftop segmentation on large GeoTIFFs.

image.alt: Main window with a satellite image and layer sidebar
image.caption: Main window

md:
A desktop app for working with satellite and aerial imagery. It stacks raster and vector layers in one map view and can run a YOLO segmentation model to find rooftops, then digitize them into a map.

[Add a sentence on who it is for and what problem it solves.]

- Layer management with a collapsible sidebar
- Rooftop detection on large GeoTIFF files
- Results exported as vectors you can open in QGIS
